segments.sn19.6:1.1: “Idhāhaṃ, āvuso, gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṃ sattilomaṃ purisaṃ vehāsaṃ gacchantaṃ.
segments.sn19.6:1.2: Tassa tā sattiyo uppatitvā uppatitvā tasseva kāye nipatanti.
segments.sn19.6:1.3: So sudaṃ aṭṭassaraṃ karoti … pe … eso, bhikkhave, satto imasmiṃyeva rājagahe māgaviko ahosi … pe ….
